text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day at a local festival, I chance
upon Narita
Brian trying her luck at the
shooting gallery.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Got it.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
A-another one?! That's insane! She's
going to get
all the prizes at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Very impressive. Now that I think of it,
you were a
good shot even when we
were little.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Nah, you were just bad.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... but...

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Another clean hit! Next up is that
colossal
beast!

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Why won't this piggy bank fall?! I
need to
hit it in a different spot! One
more shot!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't even trying for difficult
prizes... Yet you
would get prize after prize
despite only aiming for
the big ones.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's because you think too much.
Distance this,
angle that... Ever since you
were little, you always overwork that big
brain of yours.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me?! Are you saying my head is
overly
large?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Pipe down, will you? I'm trying to take
down my
last target.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Taking down your target isn't a matter
of... logic.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You gotta sniff out their weak spot with
your
instincts...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And then fire!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bullet flies through the air and
topples the
prize in spectacular fashion.

text_block_list.name: Game Operator
text_block_list.text:
Man, not my best day of business...
Well, life's full of ups and downs. Feel
free to take home all the
prizes you shot
down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Keep them. I'm only interested in the
hunt.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Although,
I will be taking that last one.

text_block_list.name: Game Operator
text_block_list.text:
You're really okay with just that? In that
case,
drop by anytime!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Here you go, Big Sis... Take it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is... a piggy bank? It looks...
strangely
familiar...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wait, Brian, is this...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe... You're quite the sister.
